messages:
maya_sec: Quick heads-up: planning a tiny canary rebuild for base-image to pick up an urgent libc patch and shrink layers. Need KMS signing window + RBAC review. Who can own key bind & logging check?

ash_infra: I can do key bind. Will create time-limited alias and grant signer role to sa-rebuild-canary for the window only.

tom_runtime: Ill run the smoke tests and verify runtime health. Which repo/tag?

maya_sec: Tag will be canary-1719004321 pushed to gcr.io/redwood/base-image. KMS path: projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/rebuild/cryptoKeys/cosign-main -> alias cosign-canary-0326. Roles: cloudkms.cryptoKeySigner + viewer.

ash_infra: Plan: grant at T-10m and revoke after 4h. Dry-run in staging first. Command: `gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding cosign-canary-0326 --keyring=rebuild --location=global --member="serviceAccount:sa-rebuild-canary@redwood-infra" --role="roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeySigner"`

maya_sec: Important: pipeline must use least privilege role roles/redwood.rebuildCanary not full image-admin. @tom_runtime can you update GH workflow to use workload identity to map sa-gh-actions to sa-rebuild-canary?

tom_runtime: Will open PR and include short-lived token exchange. Ill also add cosign verify step: `cosign verify --key gcpkms://projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/rebuild/cryptoKeys/cosign-canary-0326 gcr.io/redwood/base-image:canary-1719004321`

sam_oncall: Ill watch logs in war-room. Need someone to confirm KMS audit entries and GCR push exported to logs-to-splunk-prod sink within 15m.

ash_infra: Ill tail sink and IAM audit. If any unexpected iam role like storage.admin shows up Ill remove and alert.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary build queued  repo=gcr.io/redwood/base-image tag=canary-1719004321 sha=def456

maya_sec: Checklist after push: 1) cosign verify OK 2) smoke script ./scripts/smoke-canary.sh canary-1719004321 passes 3) KMS sign log + GCR push appear in sink 4) confirm no broad roles granted to pipeline SA

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Build pushed and signed  artifact=gcr.io/redwood/base-image:canary-1719004321 cosign_log=https://logs.redwood/cosign/1719004321

maya_sec: Leaving thread open until audit and smoke are green. Post-run note will be short: include cosign log id and any auditIDs. :thumbsup:
